text: Swimming is an amazing sport that many people enjoy. It is a great way to exercise and stay fit. To swim properly, you need to wear goggles to protect your eyes and see clearly underwater. The goggles come in different colors and styles, so you can choose the one that suits your style. Once you are in the pool, you can start by swimming laps, which means swimming in a continuous line. This helps you improve your technique and stamina. With practice, you can become a strong and fast swimmer.
